title: I Followed the Clinic Sticker After They Called My Slot a Walk-In

parts.text: I checked in at 2:09 p.m. with sticker 14 and the desk called me a walk-in. The screen said: STICKER IS THE SLOT. NO WALK-IN OVERWRITES. I was thirty-nine, patient, holding a timed text. I photographed the sticker, the screen, and the overwrite. Then I followed the sticker to the nurse who still had 14. The desk requeued the walk-in. I kept 14. The lobby finally looks like a screen, not a shuffle. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.
